cluster_ca_certificate.description: PEM-encoded root certificates bundle for TLS authentication.

kube_host.description: The hostname (in form of URI) of the Kubernetes API

token.description: Token to authenticate an service account

drain_timeout.description: Timeout for node drain operations. Defaults to `300s`.

drain_wait.description: Amount of time to wait after each node drain operation. Defaults to `60s`.

min_ready_nodes.description: Minimum number of ready nodes in the new node pool. Defaults to `1`.

node_selector_key.description: Label key used to select the nodes affected by this resource. Defaults to `cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool`.

node_selector_value.description: Label value used to select the nodes affected by this resource. Defaults to the node pool name.

ready_timeout.description: Maximum time for waiting for nodes in a new node pool to be ready. Defaults to `300s`.
